name: switchboard
description: Picks Haiku, Sonnet or Opus for each subagent before it starts, with Jev, OpenAI's Decisions API or simple rules. One line per spawn above the prompt; /route shows each pick and what it cost.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto (default) runs each subagent on the picked model. suggest only shows the pick.

picker.title: Picker
picker.description: Who picks the model. rules (default) runs on your machine and sends nothing. jev asks TypeSafe's Jev; openai asks OpenAI's Decisions API. Either sends the task's description and its first 6,000 characters to that company.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
jevApiKey.description: For picker jev, called at api.typesafe.ai. Empty uses TYPESAFE_API_KEY, then the AI Gateway key.

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway key
gatewayApiKey.description: For picker jev with no TypeSafe key: Jev through Vercel AI Gateway, served by TypeSafe only. Needs paid gateway credit. Empty uses AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY.

gatewayZeroRetention.title: Gateway zero data retention
gatewayZeroRetention.description: Ask the gateway for zero data retention. Pro and Enterprise plans only: on Hobby every pick is refused and the rules decide.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: For picker openai. Empty uses OPENAI_API_KEY.
